title: Hold Me In The Low End
description: A sparse, melancholic late-night dub roller at half-time: heavy slow Oberheim kick-and-snare under off-beat chord stabs that float in deep reverb. Voiced, dirt-flecked stabs drift through a four-chord minor progression while a sub and ghosted rim taps slowly thicken the room, intimate and dark, then strip back to a lonely outro.
